# Run evidence index

> Only for the optional full auditable protocol; ordinary high-assurance work does not require this file.

> Store as `.shiki/runs/<run-id>/status.md`; keep logs redacted. Default artifact layout: `plan.md`, `spec/vN.md`, and `evidence/{baseline,candidate,qa,review,integration}/`.
